rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for general emotional turmoil or distress when no sharper emphasis is intended.

example.english: Changing jobs lately has left me in angst all the time.
example.traditional: 最近轉工搞到我成日苦惱。
example.jyutping: zeoi3 gan6 zyun3 gung1 gaau2 dou3 ngo5 seng4 jat6 fu2 nou5

rows.note: Use this when the angst is mainly anxious apprehension, dread, or vague worry.

example.english: Whenever I think about tomorrow’s interview, I get a persistent sense of angst.
example.traditional: 一諗起聽日個面試，我就有種揮之不去嘅焦慮感。
example.jyutping: jat1 nam2 hei2 ting1 jat6 go3 min6 si5 ngo5 zau6 jau5 zung2 fai1 zi1 bat1 heoi3 ge3 ziu1 leoi6 gam2

rows.note: Use this when the emphasis is on intense emotional pain or anguish rather than anxiety.

example.english: The angst I felt after losing my close friend was truly indescribable.
example.traditional: 失去摯友之後，我心入面嗰種痛苦真係講唔出。
example.jyutping: sat1 heoi3 zi3 jau5 zi1 hau6 ngo5 sam1 jap6 min6 go2 zung2 tung3 fu2 zan1 hai6 gong2 m4 ceot1
